published.source: PR #54 (client 70425: Judgement of Righteousness 42.9%, Champion of the Light 10 / 20 / 30%, Consecration 4.2% a tick; Seal of Righteousness spell power once per the tooltip; Concentration Aura; Human, 2026-10-16)

summary: A deep Holy build to Light's Vigil (Holy Shock, Holy Power 5, Consecrated Ground, Divine Precision) with Retribution to Sacred Arbiter, on Seal of Righteousness with no twisting. It is the Holy Shock playstyle, 2.9% ahead of twist at 180 s and 4.3% at 120 s, 0.8% behind at 300 s (client 70425).
rotation: Pre-pull: Seal of Righteousness at -3 s, Light's Vigil at -1.5 s
Consecration on cooldown, down to the last point of mana
Judgement on cooldown on Seal of Righteousness; re-seal Righteousness whenever it is down (no twisting)
Light's Vigil whenever it is not on the target and mana is at or above 30%
Holy Shock on a Vigil-marked target (detonates it, refunds 75% of its mana, starts no cooldown), or on cooldown below 30% mana; Divine Favor goes on a Holy Shock
Racials, Goblin Sapper, Major Mana Potion and Demonic Rune on free GCDs
consumes: Elixir of Greater Firepower (Forever's Holy Power elixir)
caveats: Two synthetic item level 71 trinkets (Forever's launch trinkets aren't simulated): 32 spell power and 18 crit rating, and 140 spell power for 20 s every 2 min, used in the opening seconds and again on cooldown
Runs short of mana: 4.3% ahead of twist at 120 s (867.1 / 831.2), 2.9% at 180 s, 0.8% behind at 300 s
Divine Precision's hit does not cover Judgement of Righteousness
Holy Shock is worth 148 DPS and Light's Vigil about 91 (measured before client 70425)
A missed Holy Shock consumes the Vigil with no detonation or refund (small at about 1% Holy miss)
Human is best since client 70425 (Ruthless, 2% crit with any weapon): about 2 to 3 ahead of Undead (Touch of the Grave) at 180 s
Holy Strike's flat part inside the 50% weapon percent comes from client data, not yet confirmed on the beta
High Holy Strike and Consecration ranks may be stale: holding them to their level 30 trend would cost about 1.2%

Seal of Righteousness adds 12% of spell power a hit with a two-hander, once, per the 70425 tooltip (the proc spell itself carries 0): the SoD-style double count (2 x 11%) would be about 46-51 DPS higher, the proc spell's 0 about 53-59 lower
notes: Preset options are primarySeal Righteousness, as mksettings writes.
